name: Columns
description: A collection of Column objects that represent the columns in a table.
remarks: Use the Columns property of a Range, Selection, or Table object to return a Columns collection. The following example displays the number of Column objects in the Columns collection for the first table in the active document. The following example creates a table with six columns and three rows and then formats each column with a progressively larger (darker) shading percentage. Use the Add method to add a column to a table. The following example adds a column to the first table in the active document, and then it makes the column widths equal. Use Columns (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single Column object. The index number represents the position of the column in the Columns collection (counting from left to right). The following example selects the first column in the first table.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of columns in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Columns object.

properties.name: First
properties.description: Returns a Column object that represents the first item in the Columns collection.

properties.name: Last
properties.description: Returns a Column object that represents the last column in a table.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the specified columns, in points. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that represents all the borders for the specified columns.

properties.name: Shading
properties.description: Returns a Shading object that refers to the shading formatting for the specified table columns.

properties.name: NestingLevel
properties.description: Returns the nesting level of the specified columns. Read-only Long.

properties.name: PreferredWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the preferred width (in points or as a percentage of the window width) for the specified columns. Read/write Single.

properties.name: PreferredWidthType
properties.description: Returns or sets the preferred unit of measurement to use for the width of the specified cells, columns, or table. Read/write WdPreferredWidthType.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Column object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns a Column object that represents a column added to a table.

parameters.name: BeforeColumn
parameters.description: A Column object that represents the column that will appear immediately to the right of the new column.

methods.name: SetWidth
methods.signature: SetWidth(ColumnWidth As Single, RulerStyle As WdRulerStyle)
methods.description: Sets the width of columns in a table.

parameters.name: ColumnWidth
parameters.description: The width of the specified column or columns, in points.

parameters.name: RulerStyle
parameters.description: Controls the way Word adjusts cell widths.

methods.name: AutoFit
methods.description: Changes the width of a table column to accommodate the width of the text without changing the way text wraps in the cells.

methods.name: DistributeWidth
methods.description: Adjusts the width of the specified columns so that they are equal.
